hooks.command: i=$(cat); p=$(printf %s "$i" | jq -r ".cwd // \"?\""); m=$(printf %s "$i" | jq -r ".message // \"작업 끝 — 입력 대기\""); osascript -e "on run a" -e "display notification (item 2 of a) with title (item 1 of a) sound name \"Glass\"" -e "end run" "Claude · ${p##*/}" "$m" 2>/dev/null || true

i=$(cat); p=$(printf %s "$i" | jq -r ".cwd // \"?\""); m=$(printf %s "$i" | jq -r ".message // \"작업 끝 — 입력 대기\""); osascript -e "on run a" -e "display notification (item 2 of a) with title (item 1 of a) sound name \"Glass\"" -e "end run" "Claude · ${p##*/}" "$m" 2>/dev/null || true
